newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Handlowy rates WBK as "hold".
newsitem.headline: Polish Handlowy rates WBK as "hold".

text.p: The brokerage unit of Bank Handlowy SA rated Polish Wielkopolski Bank Kredytowy (WBK) as hold stressing its strong position in Poland and good financial results, Handlowy said in its report dated October 11.
It said, however, that the recent months' surge in the bank's shares could soon make the the stock overvalued.

"Taking into account fundamentals, we believe that WBK has good perspectives of development. But one should notice the stock's growth in the last several months...This is why we recommend medium-term investors to hold WBK's shares," it said.
WBK has surged 47.7 percent since the beginning of August, to 19.5 zlotys on Monday.
The brokerage said it saw WBK's net profit rising to 161.5 million zlotys in 1996 and to 180.2 million next year, up from last year's 115.8 million.
It expected WBK's revenues from interest to grow to 367.6 million zlotys in 1996 and 410.9 million in 1997, up from last year's 274.8 million zlotys.
